title: Data Modeling, Indexing & Storage Engines
docTitle: Data Modeling, Indexing & Storage Engines - SDE Prep Dojo
description: Design a schema from access patterns, pick the right indexes, understand B-tree vs LSM-tree storage engines, isolation levels, MVCC and locking - from first principles to interview answers.

hero.html:
Level 3 - Intermediate 45 min HLD concept

Data Modeling, Indexing & Storage Engines

By the end you can turn any interview prompt into tables and keys, say exactly which index serves each query, explain why Cassandra writes fast and Postgres reads fast, and pick the right isolation level and lock for a booking or payment.

sections.title: Transactions and isolation levels
sections.before:
Stop here for SDE-1. Schema from access patterns, normalization, indexes and B-tree vs LSM are the must-know part. Isolation levels, MVCC and locking below are SDE-2 depth, though "how do you stop two people booking the last seat" can come up at any level, so read the locking section once.
